questions: Is the oscillation present when you look straight ahead?
Does the oscillation change direction or intensity when you look to one side?
Do you have a history of nystagmus since childhood?
Have you recently started any new medications, particularly anti-seizure drugs like phenytoin or carbamazepine?
Do you have a history of multiple sclerosis?
Do you have a history of stroke or brain injury?
Do you consume alcohol heavily or use sedatives regularly?
Do you have difficulty walking or maintaining balance?
